value: DenseNet121 with liver+spleen+difference channels + attenuation stats

Main streamlined DenseNet training script.
Main changes:
- switch from independently resized liver/spleen crops to a shared union crop so relative organ context is preserved
- use channels: full shared crop, liver-masked crop, spleen-masked crop
- keep augmentation attenuation-safe by removing brightness/contrast shifts
- use moderate regularization and a mild combined AUC+recall score
Uses 3 input channels:
1) full shared abdomen crop around liver+spleen
2) liver-masked shared crop
3) spleen-masked shared crop
and concatenates attenuation stats before final classification.
